The '''Respite-4 escape pod''' was an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] designed by [[Tagge Company/Legends|TaggeCo]]. They were usually installed on [[Space station/Legends|space stations]]. They could seat 4 passengers and could maintain life support for three [[Standard day/Legends|standard days]].<ref name="HS" />
